senses.gloss: One and only one time.
Upon that; thereon.
Someone who claims to be knowledgeable or an expert in something, obnoxiously dismissing the opinions, advice, suggestions, etc. of others.
For that; in return for that.
Not to attend (some event, especially a class or a meeting).
Nevertheless; yet, still; in spite of that.
In spite of what preceded; yet.
(archaic) Be that as it may; nevertheless.
Most of the time; less than always, but more than occasionally.
Usually or as a general rule; commonly.
The large, usually yellowish-green or black, savory fruit of the avocado tree.
To move with rhythmic steps or movements, especially in time to music.
(transitive) To give a tremulous tone to; to trill.
(intransitive, colloquial) To dance, originally to jive or swing music; later, to jazz, rock and roll, rhythm and blues, disco, etc.
(US, idiomatic, slang) Insignificant or worthless.
Low or reduced in price.
Involving little expense; reasonable in price; cheap.
dried plum
Any form of personal, retaliatory action against an individual, institution, or group for some alleged or perceived harm or injustice.
Revenge taken for an insult, injury, or other wrong.
Violent or otherwise punitive response to an act of harm or perceived injustice; a hitting back; revenge.
Punishment inflicted in the spirit of moral outrage or personal vengeance.
Revenge or retaliation.
To recite.
To speak aloud words or other information that is written. (often construed with a to phrase or an indirect object)
To take a course or courses on a subject.
(transitive) To repeat aloud (some passage, poem or other text previously memorized, or in front of one's eyes), often before an audience.

To recite, e.g., poetry, in a theatrical way; to speak for rhetorical display; to speak pompously, noisily, or theatrically; bemouth; to make an empty speech; to rehearse trite arguments in debate; to rant.
Any of species Dermochelys coriacea, of large sea turtles, with leathery backs.

A river in the Middle East, 2780 kilometers in length, flowing southwest from Turkey, then southeast, and uniting with the Tigris before entering the Persian Gulf. It forms the Western edge of classical Mesopotamia.
To stupefy by doping with chemical substances such as alcohol.
A feeling of illness or discomfort in the digestive system, usually characterized by a strong urge to vomit.
The act of discovering something by chance, an instance of finding something by chance.
The inner and somewhat concave part of the human hand or other primate hand that extends from the wrist to the bases of the fingers.
To wonder, think of deeply.
having more than one element, part, component or function
A permission to enter.
To take as husband or wife.
(transitive) To perform the marriage ceremony for; to join in matrimony.
(transitive) To marry.
(ambitransitive) To marry (a woman).
Attestation of a fact or event; testimony.
A narrow-edged tooth at the front of the mouth of mammals, between the canines and adapted for cutting; in humans there are four in each jaw.
A trench; a long, shallow indentation, as for irrigation or drainage.
A long, narrow ditch or hole in the ground; either manmade, or formed naturally through erosion or tectonic plate movement.
A deep, wide defensive ditch, normally filled with water, surrounding a fortified habitation.
A ditch or moat.
(military) A small pit dug into the ground as a shelter for protection against enemy fire.
The act of burning something with fire.
Advice or counselling on some topic.
Any of certain aquatic birds of the family Anatidae, having a flat bill and webbed feet, distinguished from swans and geese by generally being smaller and shorter-necked.
(aviation) A type of aircraft in which the primary horizontal control and stabilization surfaces are in front of the main wing.
The edible fruit of this tree.
A pan used for urination and defecation while in bed, now usually for reasons of medical necessity or convenience.
One of the four elements of the ancient Greeks and Romans; air.
Of a person: a source of inspiration.
A leader of a clan or tribe.
Any of the manners by which living beings perceive the physical world: for humans sight, smell, hearing, touch, taste.
A physical feeling or perception from something that comes into contact with the body; something sensed.
A female member of a religious order; especially one devoted to more active service; (informal) a nun.
A member of a Christian religious community of women who live by certain vows and usually wear a habit, (Roman Catholicism, specifically) those living together in a cloister.
A woman with religious duties and responsibilities in certain religions.
Influenced or changed by something.
strongly affected, especially favourably
person who comments
(architecture) A beam anchored at one end and projecting into space, such as a long bracket projecting from a wall to support a balcony.
A part of a rowing boat's equipment used to provide leverage for a rowing blade or oar around a fixed fulcrum.
(nautical) Any of various projecting beams or spars that provide support for a sailing ship's mast.
present participle and gerund of fuck
Persistent acts intended to make life unpleasant for another person.
A government in which a single ruler (a tyrant) has absolute power, or this system of government; especially, one that acts cruelly and unjustly.
Operated, or activated, by placing coins in a slot.
Somewhat white, pale or almost white.
Severe or cruel.
Unfeeling, heartless, cruel, insensitive.
An event or occurrence that signifies an ending.

The confinement of people in their own rooms (e.g., in a school) or cells (in a prison), or to their own homes or areas (e.g., in the case of a city- or nation-wide issue) as a security measure after or amid a disturbance or as a non-pharmaceutical intervention in a pandemic.
Advocating or seeking the separation of one country or territory into two politically independent countries or territories.
A state of the United States, named for the people.
Of or pertaining to differentiation or the differential calculus.
The study of the relationship between food and culture.
Inflammation of the meninges, characterized by headache, neck stiffness and photophobia and also fever, chills, vomiting and myalgia.

Any plant of the genus Plantago, with a rosette of sessile leaves about 10 cm (4") long with a narrow part instead of a petiole, and with a spike inflorescence with the flower spacing varying widely among the species. See also psyllium.
Former name of Khujand: a city in Tajikistan.
A city and associated province of Piedmont, Italy.
Having a grain or grains.
Synonym of micrometre (“one-millionth of a metre”).
Easily driven to anger, usually with reference to a person.
Having the power of driving or impelling; giving an impulse; moving; impellent.
(figuratively) Having a fiery temperament.
To deliberately remove the head of; to cut off (someone's) head.
(logic) Freedom from contradiction; the state of a system of axioms such that none of the propositions deduced from them are mutually contradictory.
The patchy loss of skin pigmentation.
A mottled marking, usually in clusters.
(archaeology) The application of techniques and methodologies of the natural sciences to archaeology, mostly for dating, analysis, survey and confirmation of provenance or authenticity.
A coastal city in the Southern District of Israel on the Mediterranean coast.
A grove of small growth; a thicket of brushwood; a wood cut at certain times for fuel or other purposes, typically managed to promote growth and ensure a reliable supply of timber. See copse.
to lower into a liquid — see also dunk
A hinged bridge which can be raised (to prevent its being crossed, as across a moat, or to allow watercraft to travel beneath it).
The act of individualizing; the state of being individualized.
An old walled city, the prefecture of Aude department, Occitania, France.
A shrill noise, especially made by a voice or bird. If made by a bird, it typically signals discomfort or anger; a yell, scream, or call.
(philosophy) Ecumenical doctrines and practices, especially as manifested in the ecumenical movement.
The rise and fall of the voice in speaking.
The act of postponing, delaying or putting off, especially habitually or intentionally.
The state or quality of being unique or one of a kind.
A set of small cages where hens are kept for the purpose of farming their eggs.
Of uncertain, risky outcome.
Talk, especially meaningless or unimportant talk.
A long meandering talk with no specific topic or direction.
(North America, archaic, _, in Britain) Talk, especially unnecessary talk; chatter. [from Template:SAFESUBST: c.]
(dated) Confused and incoherent talk; nonsense.
Talk to little purpose; trifling talk; unmeaningful loquacity.
The state of having little (or less) weight, or little force.
The state or quality of being light, buoyancy.
The surgical removal of all or part of the liver.
fact or statement used to support a proposition; a reason
To free or liberate; to set free.
An inhabitant of Croatia, or a person of Croatian descent.
The administration of liquid substances directly into a vein for medical purposes; perfusion.
One who avenges or vindicates.
Vindictive or wanting vengeance.
A portion of a split gene that is included in pre-RNA transcripts but is removed during RNA processing and rapidly degraded.
The state of being addicted; devotion; inclination.
A member of an ethnolinguistic group that constitutes most of the population of Cambodia.
A band passed under the belly of an animal, which holds a saddle or a harness saddle in place.
Translations
Insulting, ridiculing.
The art or craft of compiling, writing, and editing dictionaries.
A seat, usually with a canopy, carried on the back of an elephant or camel.
Any of a group of Old World monkeys of the genus Macaca.
A portable percussive power tool that combines a hammer and chisel used to drill or break hard matter, for instance rock or concrete.
The print-based media (both the people and the newspapers).
To make legitimate.
A person who engages in necrophilia.
One who is subject to necrophilia.
A city, the provincial capital of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan.
Resembling bile, especially in color.
Willing to give and share unsparingly; showing a readiness to give more (especially money) than is expected or needed.
One who embalms a corpse; a practitioner of mortuary science.
One who regularly engages in public controversies.
(uncountable) The main language spoken in Thailand (closely related to Lao).
To complete, to bring to perfection, to make whole.
A heterocyclic base, 5-methylpyrimidine-2,4(1H,3H)-dione; it pairs with adenine in DNA.
(amino acid) An essential amino acid 2-amino-3-methylbutanoic acid found in most animal proteins.

The idea that beliefs are identified with the actions of a believer, and the truth of beliefs with success of those actions in securing a believer's goals; the doctrine that ideas must be looked at in terms of their practical effects and consequences.
A judge described in the Book of Judges of the Old Testament and the Hebrew Tanakh.
A small fish of subfamily Syngnathinae in the seahorse family, having a long thin body covered with partially ossified plates, the head long, and the jaws elongated so as to form a tubular snout.
A maker of boots; a cobbler.
A kind of three-stringed Japanese fretless lute.
The flowers of the hop plant, dried and used to brew beer.
